headline: Colonials Seize Scouts Jest as Nevish Line Front Cools
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, the northern front has shifted violently as Callums Cape erupted into fierce combat, with Colonial forces seizing Scouts Jest amid over 2,500 casualties in the last two hours. Mooring County continues to endure massive attrition, logging more than 4,000 combined casualties over two hours with loss rates accelerating sharply on both sides. In Marban Hollow, renewed contestation around Checkpoint Bua triggered several rapid base transitions before the wire. By contrast, the furious fighting that previously engulfed Nevish Line has cooled considerably, with casualty rates plummeting and no base flips recorded over the past two hours. Callahan's Passage has likewise settled into relative quiet following earlier engagements at Crumbling Post. Elsewhere along the line, Linn of Mercy and Stlican Shelf recorded fresh casualty surges despite static lines, while Weathered Expanse logged late base shifts right up to the reporting cutoff.
